messages:
alex: Vendor uploaded the pen-test PDF and raw evidence to S3. Link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-pt/6891234567/report.pdf. Triage call tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need RBAC and KMS owners present.

maria: On it — pulling the findings now. Can you add the full evidence bundle (pcaps, access logs)? I need those for repro steps.

sam: Quick note on severity: I'll pre-classify anything that shows write access to model artifacts as high. Also we only have 7d audit logs for staging right now, we should keep 30d+ until retest.

jordan: For RBAC followups I'll export the service-account -> role map. Can someone confirm which key alias is used by model-store in prod vs staging?

alex: prod uses alias/aws/redwood-models-prod, staging uses alias/redwood-models-staging. I'll attach IAM role dump to the triage notes.

maria: Vendor requested retest window within 14 days. Proposal: critical fixes within 7 days (fast retest), non-critical in 21 days. Thoughts? :calendar:

sam: That timeline seems fine if we can commit owners. For incident response: if evidence of active exploitation is found we should isolate affected instance groups and rotate the KMS data keys, not delete keys. Example command to rotate (AWS):
```
aws kms rotate-key --key-id <key-id> --region us-west-2
```
Also enable CloudTrail lookup for the key usage.

jordan: I'll take ownership of RBAC fixes for model-store and will open tickets. I'll also request ELK retention to 90d for the flagged buckets and enable S3 object lock for evidence buckets.

security-bot: PenTest intake created: PT-6891. Initial assignees: alex, maria, sam, jordan. Evidence bundle staged at s3://redwood-pt/6891234567/evidence.zip.

alex: I'll share a remediation tracker (Jira board) before the triage call and pre-populate with the top 10 findings. Action items for the call: owners for each critical, confirm log retention to 30d+, confirm KMS rotation plan, agree retest cadence.

maria: Also flag any PII/secret exposures to legal and infosec immediately. If we find creds rotated in plaintext, immediate CSIRT activation.

sam: Added runbook snippet for immediate containment to the board: isolate node group, revoke ephemeral service tokens, rotate data-plane keys, capture forensic snapshots.

jordan: Posted Jira board: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PT-6891. Please add estimated ETA per ticket. I'll coordinate the vendor retest slots after owners sign off.

alex: Great. See you all at 10:00am PT. If anything urgent surfaces beforehand DM me or @security-bot will page oncall.
